description: Point-in-Time contract defining all timestamp fields and rules for WTILS registries and research artifacts.

timestamp_fields.description: The point-in-time at which data was queried. All data returned is guaranteed to be available at or before this timestamp.
Timestamp when the artifact/record was created.
Date from which this registry entry is effective.
Date until which this registry entry is effective. null means currently active.
Exact datetime when this contract version was introduced.
Datetime of last change to this contract. null if unchanged since introduction.
Datetime when this contract was deprecated. null if not deprecated.
Datetime when this contract was retired. null if not retired.
Timestamp when an API was actually invoked during research.
Generic event timestamp in timeline entries.

rules.description: No look-ahead: Data returned for as_of_time T must not include information that only became available after T.
Called_at <= as_of_time: Every API call timestamp must be at or before the as_of_time of the research artifact.
Version validity: An entry is active at time T if valid_from <= T and (valid_to is null or valid_to >= T).
Monotonic creation: created_at is monotonically increasing for new artifacts. Revision increments do not change created_at.
Contract ordering: introduced_at <= changed_at <= deprecated_at <= retired_at (where non-null).
Null semantics: null in nullable fields means 'not applicable' or 'not yet occurred'. Missing fields are invalid.
Replay guarantee: If a research artifact is replayed with the same as_of_time, the result must be identical (barring source changes).
